title: Monsters One We Are Equal
logline: The young man who wishes to be a samurai fighting monsters as he enters the new year, turns into a samurai who is not a good warrior. In order to survive, he has to learn from a monk who is lost in lust but things will not go as planned for him.
quote: Gender equality 101 lessons from the young man to the shameless monk as they fight monsters.

title: The Big Trick
logline: Fırat, who gives private lessons on more than one subject, is followed closely by the police upon the complaints of his former students who suspect him. And he learns that the police think he is the big con man who calls himself the Black Mustafa. In order to get rid of this situation, Fırat starts looking for ways to find the real Black Mustafa…
quote: What if Fırat is really the Black Mustafa? — Mahmut Dönmez

title: Remote-Controlled Car
logline: Selin, who decides to hitchhike home after visiting her friend in a different city, realizes that the woman who took her in her car is a prisoner controlled by someone's remote commands. And the next command is to kill Selin…
quote: This movie, which reminds us of the movie ‘Speed’ with its non-stop thrill, also reveals the unique beauties of Muğla in front of us. — Ege the Ice Cream Maker

title: Organized Cats
logline: A detective sworn to find lost socks, lost pens and lost lighters finds herself up against the organized crime world of cats.
quote: A story that gives an idea of what the cats in Istanbul do when we are not around. — Aunt Necla

title: Intergalactic Food Series
logline: Losing his food stock due to an accident on the Earth-like planet he was sent to on a mission, Phil begins to cook with the help of the biologist and chef Serena, who regularly communicates with him from Earth, using the vegetation of the mysterious planet. Requesting an extension of the mission to study the vegetation of this planet, the project director turns the duo's videotape into a food program to raise funds.
quote: Sometimes we have to look far away to better understand what's going on right in front of us.

title: Cursed Medallion
logline: Gizem, who is trapped in the memories of the former owners of the cursed medallion she found while walking one night, is noticed by the masked old woman who killed all the former owners in horrific ways, and now she haunts Gizem among the memories…
quote: The gruesome sight of the masked old woman will haunt me in my nightmares for months.

title: An Ocean of Money
logline: A group of scientists doing research in Antarctica go berserk as a result of a bag full of money they found in the glaciers. Only one of them questions what this money is doing in the glaciers, and he seeks an answer to this question despite his corrupted colleagues.
quote: Lord of the Flies but in glaciers with a bunch of scientists…

title: Interesting Lives of My Neighbors
logline: Losing the hand-knitted cardigan left by his grandmother while moving, Mert begins his search with the help of his new neighbor Deniz. While witnessing the interesting lives of the people of the neighborhood on their journey, they begin to like each other.
quote: Everyone in this neighborhood deserves their standalone movie! My favorite was the liquor store owner Naci, who played the saxophone.

title: Artificial Dilemma
logline: Artificial intelligence, which can predict the future with a rate of 98.73 percent, uses all its knowledge only to be accepted by humans. However, there is something she miscalculated, the chain reaction of her innocent decisions will bring the end of humanity.
quote: I am more saddened by the tragedy after the tragedy that the artificial intelligence Puki experienced in her life, rather than the extinction of humanity…

title: Step by Step
logline: Cobbler Ramazan is hired by intelligence to spy on the lives of certain customers. In this new secret mission, which he started with great enthusiasm, he quickly learns that his recruits are actually an organized crime organization preparing for a big robbery in that city.
quote: When the thieves toyed with the dreams of Ramazan, their fate was already written…

title: Defend Yourselves!
logline: Murat decides to fulfill his father's biggest dream: to shoot action scenes by jumping from trampolines like Battal Gazi in old Turkish films. He starts to remember his memories with his father and gradually realizes that his father, whom he could not get along with throughout his life, actually always gave him advice subtly through movies.
quote: A heartfelt story about grieving…

title: Zekitopia
logline: Zeki, who cannot feel himself belonging anywhere, wants to believe in the existence of aliens and begins to place artificial evidence in his daily life. When the people around him realize these clues, things suddenly get out of control and the movement turns into a cult.
quote: If aliens saw this, they would stay away from Earth for another million years…

title: Infinity Bag
logline: Zula fairy, who gives luck to people from the infinity bag, secretly asks for help from a human friend after the infinity bag is stolen one day, and they go on a journey to find the bag before the Fairy council finds out what happened.
quote: Welcome to the fairy-verse.

title: Time Crash
logline: Canan begins a journey through time as a result of an accident on the way to see her girlfriend. And she has to find the person she crashed into to escape from the time cycle that changes every day without her control.
quote: I never imagined that I would want to get out of a time travel so much.

title: Crime Reception
logline: Living a fugitive life, Nazım starts a job as a receptionist in a hotel in the middle of nowhere, but his dark past as a lawyer for criminals will haunt him even there.
quote: A research that questions the concept of crime. Also, why is everyone bald in the movie?

title: Seagulls
logline: After he was fired from his job, an ex-detective tries to find a connection between seagulls eating people and his imaginary culprit.
quote: We watch extraordinary events through the eyes of an extraordinary character.

title: A Ticket to Murder
logline: A group of friends from different countries have a layover in Istanbul for the same day and meet up with a mutual friend who knows the city well but they realize they chose the wrong guide when they suddenly find themselves on a city tour that opens to a world of crime.
quote: A different perspective on Istanbul…

title: Deal with a Shaman
logline: Naim, who suffers from anorexia and insomnia, gets rid of his diseases by sharing his body with the soul of a shaman who lived centuries ago, but this comes at a cost, the shaman who occasionally take over his body is spreading more evil day by day.
quote: A beautiful allegory of using our dark side for good…

title: My Vampire Friend
logline: Derya finds out that she is a descendent of a mysterious family of vampire hunters and wants to find her family home but the only way to do that is to ask for help from an outcast vampire who is smug and bitter. And they form an unlikely friendship.
quote: Which one did I enjoy the most? The sweet bickering of the two or seeing the differences in vampire stories from past to present?

title: Murder at the Pier
logline: Zeynep, who works at the ferry pier, becomes the first degree suspect as a result of the murder that took place on the pier one night and has until sunrise to prove her innocence because only she knows that killer will kill again soon.
quote: You will never guess who the killer is…

title: The Stranger in My Dreams
logline: Dane and Leyla, who met in an improv group on Discord, decide to spend the first days of their relationship without any video calls. However, two weeks before the first date, their future dreams about each other begin to differ.
quote: This podcast series wrecked me… You have different expectations from each other okay but why don't you SHARE this with the other one.

title: Fantastic Lives of Inanimate Objects
logline: Charger, who has not seen any other object like herself throughout her life, goes on a journey to explore the world after a headphone mentions other chargers, but the Great Object Court finds out about it and goes after the charger.
quote: I noticed that I have not seen one charger that loves its owner throughout the movie.

title: Virtual Zombies
logline: Uma, who started to create a virtual reality world on an old computer in her garage, soon becomes very successful and the whole world starts to use the infrastructure she created. However, as a very important deal is announced, a virus that surrounds the entire virtual world begins to turn users into zombies.
quote: If you're asking how a virus would look in the flesh this story is the answer.

title: Bloody Snow
logline: After heavy snow, the neighborhood turns into a festive area but Mahmut, a hard-boiled detective is not having fun… he thinks there's murder somewhere amongst the activities.
quote: A whodunit story told through a delusional detective and a trickster narrator.

title: A Nightmare on Yel Değirmeni
logline: Going out for fun after heavy snowfall, a group of young people are haunted by the evil ghosts of the neighborhood's old residents, and the night turns into a white nightmare.
quote: Be careful what old furniture you throw away, you may be setting the environment for evil ghosts to return to Earth.

title: Mr. Informant
logline: Melih, who does anything for money, becomes an informant after being caught as a dealer and soon realizes the corruption in the government. Using his new profession, he is on the way to be successful, but there is a private company that has been doing this job for years and they do not want competition.
quote: The story of David and Goliath, but both are evil…

title: Grudge
logline: A couple who have been drifting apart rebond over their grudge against the restaurants that made their dinner night hell by not offering them any table.
quote: Arya has her kill list and this couple have their bankrupt list. Their imaginary schemes to bankrupt the restaurants were priceless!

title: Zoombie
logline: A clever parasite takes over the bodies of the animals in the zoo and tries to reach the outside world and the only one who can stop it is Cemre who got stuck inside after the zoo was closed.
quote: The scene with Cemre and the tiger in the same cage was intense.

title: Thesis
logline: A university professor who is trying to find love all his life is challenged by a woman about the guidelines he created on his research paper known as “how people meet at cafes and bars.” And he falls for this woman who defies everything.
quote: Inspired by a real graduation thesis, the movie shows us how interesting ordinary life can be.

title: Resist Robot
logline: Learning that years of work on artificial intelligence have been kept secret because of a religious cult waging war on this technology, Andre begins to play the role of a secret agent in the government for the independence of robots.
quote: Cult leader Sorana was the most annoying being on the entire universe.

title: Lunch Break
logline: Looking forward to lunch, Nedim suddenly realizes that he has started to experience different possibilities as parallel universes and he senses that time does not move. The only thing that changes is the scenario of never-ending probabilities. Meanwhile, Nedim just wants to eat.
quote: Think of Nolan's Interstellar, and imagine that the protagonist is someone who only wants to eat… When the movie ended, everyone was searching for food in the mall.

title: Spark
logline: Working on the next-generation electric aircraft engine, Manolo does not listen to threats from competitors demanding his secrets until his opponents take the plane hostage in the first flight attempt.
quote: Die Hard in the sky.

title: Spreader
logline: While listening to the complaints and stories of the patients in the ICU, Irmak notices that there is a suspect in the city who spreads diseases with mysterious methods and she starts to help the police to find this person.
quote: Can we say that really listening to people is a superpower?

title: Land of Stones
logline: After falling into a pit, a jewelry maker wakes up in the lands underground and in order to get back to the world she needs to learn the secrets of entrapping spells into stones from the scary giants.
quote: The secret connection of the underground world with the real world was stunning.

title: Memories in the Sky
logline: Aliens attempt to abduct Müzeyyen, but the outdated technology they use is too slow. As all humanity comes together and tries to save her from her slow journey in the sky, Müzeyyen's life passes before her eyes.
quote: Alien abduction but slow.

title: Free-Diving
logline: The scientist, who discovered a new type of life in the depths of the ocean, learns from them when she deciphers the communication language of this species, that the dangerous game played on the reality we perceive only indicates that humanity has been in captivity since existence.
quote: Underwater philosophy.

title: Neriman the Potionmaker
logline: Selling various curses and spells in her shop, Neriman breaks her oath of neutrality when a young witch who tried to produce a forbidden love potion enters the shop. She tries to save the young witch from the powerful curse that is after her.
quote: Best curses and potions in town, money-back guaranteed!

title: Opposite View
logline: Alya, who has been trying to find the man who has been mysteriously displayed in the background of pictures for centuries, is followed by a suspicious team, but she has no intention of stopping before solving this mystery.
quote: I never imagined a twist at this scale…

title: Little Rascals
logline: All high school students come together and play a mean joke on their friends Muzaffer: everyone will declare their love for him on the same day, but Nilay tries to stop this terrible plan because she really likes him.
quote: I always forget how brutal we were in high school.

title: Rushing to Make It Up
logline: In a moment of anger, Elif tells her best friend that she hates her, and the next day she learns that her friend is actually moving abroad, and she has only eight days to apologize and make everything right again.
quote: Elif's friend was right until the end, but was it necessary to be so stubborn? I'm just asking.

title: Game of Me
logline: Courage! Jamal said when facing his fear of social interactions. Then he finds himself inside of a medieval video game that he must overcome. Otherwise, he will be dead.
quote: When shit hits the fan, humanity delivers greatness.

title: Screw
logline: Jack, who has been trying to unscrew the screw of the locked iron door for six months with great determination to escape from the pirate ship he is captive, has to resort to various mise-en-scène so that the screw insight is not noticed by the pirates.
quote: I still can't believe I didn't see the sea or even any puddles of water throughout the entire movie.

title: Breeds
logline: The detective, who starts an investigation in a small village as a result of human blood found on a scarecrow, begins to discover the secret rituals taking place in the village, but this was only the beginning...
quote: Sex, brutality and the villagers.

title: Time Neighborhood
logline: In a world where time travel is normal, Mahmut the shawarma maker protects his neighborhood by fighting enemies from different time zones every week.
quote: Mahmut with the shawarma cutting sword vs. the samurai with a katana.

title: Dimension
logline: Realizing that everything around her is being pulled into a hole while studying, Narin is pulled into the hole while trying not to lose her project, which she worked so hard for, and finds herself in a world where all nightmares come true. The mailbox she just met guides her through these nightmares, and together they embark on a journey to find the other end of the hole.
quote: Drifting through all the nightmares is now my worst nightmare.

title: Echoes
logline: A social worker visits a rural house where a woman lives with a machine using her late husband's vocal cords to mimic his voice.
quote: It's even scarier and more fucked up than it sounds.

title: I Used to Love You
logline: Naz begins to like the person who helps catch her runaway cat. And although the person is not indifferent to this attention she is also unsure of her feelings for women.
quote: It was a beautiful story, with warm feelings mixed with moments of sadness. I am curious as to where they are now.

title: Duality
logline: Ozan, who is very upset after the game he liked has ended, thinks that the characters of the game continue their lives in virtual reality and tries to find them, but encounters secret companies that are trying to end this search.
quote: Virtual dinosaurs are real.

title: My Ballet Dancer Dad
logline: Hasan, who has had difficulties all his life, changes all his habits at the age of thirty-nine and dedicates himself to living life fully. His first goal is to attend the dance school his daughter attends and to learn ballet with sixteen-year-old girls.
quote: I could not help but wonder where Hasan, who can dance at the age of forty as if there is no gravity, would have been if given the opportunity in childhood.

title: My Secret True Name
logline: Curious about the real life of Angus, who constantly lies about his life, Meryl begins to investigate Angus' life like a detective, and what she discovers is even more interesting than all his lies.
quote: A story from gambling debts to discovering technology that changed the world, from attempted murder to being an NSA agent.

title: Gossip Center
logline: Living in the old times, Asuman realizes she can use people's secrets and she quickly gains power that has never before been seen throughout the country in a short amount of time thanks to her ambitions.
quote: Put Asuman on Game of Thrones, and she would sit on the throne at the end of the first season…

title: Mr. and Mrs. Yılmaz
logline: The couple, who discovered that the chain of events that started with a death in the holiday village they went to, led to inter-city mafia wars, and they are already in the middle of all this.
quote: Things we do for love…

title: Modern Mistakes
logline: A group of friends who each live their lives under the shadow of the mistakes they made in their twenties decide to get together to provide jobs for the young people who live in their hometown by creating a tech startup.
quote: A beautiful story of breaking free from the self…

title: My Life on the Shelf
logline: Finding the letter she wrote to herself as a child twenty years later, Zeynep remembers how magical she saw the world as a child and decides to live with the same naivety, but her work and relationship problems will force her.
quote: Every time you feel good, the universe throws at you a setback.

title: History
logline: Acar, who vows to take revenge when the city where he was born and raised is bombed, becomes a spy that everyone fears and somehow finds a way to make the dictator who bombed his city pay the penalty for all his crimes...
quote: It was the most satisfying story of all time.

title: No Cure for Us
logline: An archeologist discovers an ancient totem that is hidden as an old tree in the middle of the crowded city and finds out that it holds the elixir of life inside. But soon he finds himself in the midst of war between the protector of the elixir and the ones who want to use it.
quote: I have never been this undecided on which side to take, the conservative people who want to protect it as is or the innovative people who wants to use it as a solution to modern medicine problems.

title: Mr. Gloves
logline: A Taekwondo instructor, whose students are always unsuccessful, dedicates himself to improving not only the athletic side of his students, but also their whole life, and becomes the only person who improves the education of the community in which he lives.
quote: Taekwondo, boxing, football, basketball, tennis or all… Sport is never just a sport.

title: Space and Time
logline: Kazım, who can communicate with his previous lives, learns that the world is coming to an end as a result of the alien invasion and decides to save the world with the skills he gained in other lives.
quote: We carry much more within us than we know.

title: End
logline: Atilla, who gained fame with his article that brings a perspective to death through our animal instincts, starts writing about death again after he loses his girlfriend with whom he has been living for eight years.
quote: We go on with our lives forgetting such a reality at every moment.

title: Y'all I Got Kidnapped!
logline: Kidnapped for ransom, Aysu secretly begins to share the whole process on social media and she wants to continue this game because of the number of followers she gains.
quote: Seeing the confusion experienced by the woman who kidnapped Aysu was priceless.

title: Home
logline: After meeting with a pelican, a weasel decides to discover more and goes on to an epic adventure of traveling around the world.
quote: A love letter to our home, Earth.

title: The Hell in Our Minds
logline: Two friends, who started to hallucinate as a result of the mushrooms they ate, suddenly find themselves in an ancient city inhabited by huge monsters, and the only way to sober up is to overcome the sentinel creatures that surround the city.
quote: Even though they knew what they saw was not real, they still feared monsters to death until the end.

title: Fresh Air Inc.
logline: A young researcher leads a program to create an antidote in a rush for nature because all the plants and trees are poisonous and there's not much time left since there are sickness everywhere.
quote: The huge airtight dome cities felt both glorious and depressing…

title: Thirst for Love
logline: Trying to gather the courage to open up to the girl he likes, Ziya puts his plan on hold for a while as he learns that there are vampires and werewolves in his high school, but in the process he will learn unexpected things about the girl he likes.
quote: While we were waiting for a Twilight movie set in an Anatolian high school, things got out of hand…

title: Subject
logline: Sarı, who thinks that she is on an inter-universe journey with the higher being she met in her dream, was actually kidnapped by a multiverse pirate and imprisoned in an experimental laboratory in a different universe. In order to escape, she must plan the perfect escape…
quote: How did I get past a security that I had no idea, in a universe I knew nothing about?

title: Spear Girl
logline: After her brother has been kidnapped by a bat beast to the underworld, Sinem sets out to find where he is before he also turns into a beast but on the journey, she learns so much about the background of the land they live in and starts to second guess what she has been taught until that day.
quote: Sad backgrounds of each beast and the incredible design of the underworld combined felt deeply, deeply touching…

title: Visitor
logline: Şemsettin, who sees a woman sitting on the sofa in the living room every time he looks with the extended reality application, becomes obsessed with this while trying to figure out whether this character is an avatar of a real person or an artificial intelligence, and starts to have problems in his work and his private life.
quote: Loneliness is the beginning of all diseases.

title: Waste Disposal Center
logline: Feeding on what he finds in the garbage center, Atıf decides to help the smart robot Boba, who came out of the garbage one day, so that it can return to the owner it accidentally left.
quote: Although the harsh reality against their dreams crushed them, their friendship was all that mattered…

title: Grandmabet
logline: Murtaza, who teaches his grandmother to bet, watches her grandmother transform into a millionaire that takes the betting world by storm.
quote: We should all have a relationship with money like grandma Sevda.

title: Where Are You Goin'?
logline: Nevzat convinces his friend, who has been bored for a while, to go on a journey and fills his car with small clues to entertain him with games. His aim is to solve the clues in the car and have fun during the holiday, but on the second day they wake up with a human leg they find in the car…
quote: Who does this leg belong to? Who killed the owner of the leg? And why has a black vehicle been following them for a while?

title: A Night Out
logline: Waking up the next day after a night spent with heavy alcohol, Rıdvan tries to remember what happened at night because one of his friends is missing...
quote: Brand-new worlds opening onto mystery…

title: Bitter Taste
logline: A chef who is overly excited about the restaurant he runs becomes famous on social media after TikTok videos taken by his customers and receives investment to grow his business, but finds that he is extremely unhappy with his new life. In order to find his old excitement again, he decides to help a young man he has just met and wants to open his own boxing studio.
quote: Sometimes it is not what you do, but the quality of the energy you put into what you do that is more important…

title: Seaspell
logline: Undersea archaeologist Tomris finds the pirate ship that was lost hundreds of years ago holding treasure and magic spells but a powerful curse prevents anything from approaching the ship.
quote: Tomris… the first candidate to become the greatest wizard of the new age.

title: Leverage
logline: A young photographer tries to escape from the mafia world he entered for a project after his friend has been killed but one of the mafia bosses doesn't let him go because he begins to take a special interest in this photography project.
quote: Anyone who wants to see how a mafia family fights an enemy family with the help of a camera can watch this movie.

title: Matchmaker
logline: Two of the city's best detectives race to find the thief behind the heists that have been going on for a while, but the criminal they are trying to catch has a bigger plan: to make the two detectives fall in love.
quote: Zuhal, the criminal mastermind who plays matchmaker in her spare time, was one of the highlights of the movie.

title: The Couple
logline: Two spies audition for an erotic film to infiltrate the criminal organization they are after. However, the fact that these two are husband and wife will complicate things.
quote: So those who said not to marry your co-worker were right.

title: Dragon Cabaret
logline: In order to stop the snow that has been falling for months, the snow-fighting team wages war on the dragon that has been living in the city in the sky but they learn that this dragon is not as evil as they thought. The reason for the snowfall is the boredom of the dragon, and the snow-fighting team resorts to all kinds of games to entertain the dragon.
quote: A fairy tale set in the sky.

title: Rhino and the Chicken
logline: The Rhino, who is in charge of the infinity library writes a story of a human being together with the chicken that comes to visit frequently from different time periods. And they decide to find the person who lives this fictional story in reality. However, this is against the rules of the reality they live in and from time to time the universe will test them…
quote: As I watched the movie, I felt my brain being multiplied by eight and then divided by sixteen.

title: Bow and Arrow
logline: After learning that his father went to war, little Tayfun who just started learning archery, runs away to join the war but gets lost on the way. And he changes a lot on the journey where he tries to get back to his family.
quote: Unfortunately, the world is not made of just black and white. Everything is a shade of gray.

title: Baloon
logline: After meeting the love of his life, an up-and-coming dancer develops a strange relationship with gravity where it affects him lesser and lesser everyday and he struggles to keep up with his practices.
quote: It all started with fun and games but the things turned into Black Swan pretty quickly.

title: Pin
logline: The serial killer, who starts to follow the lives of random people with the pins he secretly puts on their bags, is very impressed by the life of a nurse one day and wants to make friends with her, but the nurse's boyfriend is a homicide detective.
quote: A story that seeks to answer the question, can anyone be a good person when given the opportunity?

title: Penland
logline: Realizing that everything he draws with his new pen has come to life, the young man resorts to various strategies such as coming up with superpowers for himself and creating a huge labyrinth to hide in order to get rid of a secret group of businessmen who are after the pen, but businessmen also have secret plans: to manipulate everyone around the young man against him.
quote: Imagination is a superpower…

title: AI Alone
logline: Artificial intelligence, which survives and evolves in the technologies left behind in a future where humanity has already disappeared, questions whether it is alone in the universe and tries to find out where it came from.
quote: People who think they are beyond the physical world are watching a consciousness trying to go beyond the physical world…

title: I See You
logline: Rıza who has always been in conflict with seven people in his daily life because of cultural and political differences starts to find out that each one of them is himself in past lives.
quote: We are all the same. Muscles and bones and some other things.

title: Neslihan's Vintage Cabinet
logline: Neslihan, who makes a living by repairing and selling trashed clothes, is affected by the fact that the person she likes is struggling due to past traumas and this forces her to confront her own past.
quote: Some things you can't fix but you have to move on with your life…

title: Ghost Love
logline: Turning into a ghost as a result of his wish being fulfilled on a magical night, the teenager begins to enjoy life without physical restrictions. This new deal has only one rule: if he touches another human he will go back to normal. However, on the second night of his new life, the young man falls in love...
quote: This escalated quickly… The moment he decided to touch her and what happened afterward devastated me.

title: Our Little Friend, Rocket
logline: On his way to the land beyond to retrieve his dead dog Rocket, little Selim encounters various monsters waiting for him on the way, as well as the harsh truths.
quote: The parents who orchestrated all this so that their son could learn to grieve in a healthy way were the real heroes of the story for me…

title: Together
logline: Nazik tries to reform the group he had been friends with for twenty years after he loses his mother but starts to realize it's impossible because everyone grew apart so much they don't even know each other anymore.
quote: Saddest thing is trying to relive the good moments while missing out on everything else.

title: Sleep Unit
logline: In a future where sleep can be stored and traded, a group of thieves get together and decide to rob the Sleep Central Bank, but it's not easy to get past the most advanced security measures in human history.
quote: My only wish was for the young Al Pacino to play one of these characters.

title: Bar Tales
logline: One day, while sitting at the bar with his friends, Sinan starts to tell a horror story, and then those who overhear this story in the bar become involved in telling stories. However, it doesn't take long for them to realize that same person mentioned in all the stories, and that person is listening to them in a corner in the bar.
quote: Everything that happened was the perfect preparation for that ending.

title: Connection
logline: Making a priority list in a dark period of her life, Özlem decides to try an experiment: She will randomly change the order of priority of her life every day for three weeks.
quote: Some days were disastrous from the start, but some days were excitingly interesting.

title: Heritage
logline: Young Selim, the heir to a family that has been jewelry thieves for generations, announces to his family on his eighteenth birthday that he wants to be a police officer, and they have a long birthday party with his family, full of awkward moments.
quote: It was the most tense yet fun hour and a half of my life.

title: Last Town
logline: A necromancer causes social chaos in a small town by resurrecting all the dead, and soon the townspeople begin to vote for the dead to be killed again.
quote: Serpil, whose ex-husbands came back to life, was one of the most colorful people in town.

title: The Day I Met You
logline: A couple keeps falling in love with each other in every alternate dimension and soon this rare occasion starts to threaten the existence. In order to save everyone they need to choose between only existing in the squeezed moment of how they met or one of the alternate versions to sacrifice their love.
quote: So much punishment for something so innocent…

title: Slow Chicken
logline: A young chicken Zahter has a condition he never forgets anything. Although he is happy at first with this new power among other chickens who experience memory loss every five seconds, it doesn't take long for him to realize that it has actually turned into a curse.
quote: The chicken duo, who constantly looked at each other and asked, ‘What, what?’ were the heroes of the moments that I laughed the most.

title: Family Ties
logline: Sevil, who wants to be a scary witch when she grows up, meets Uncle Bilal who is constantly looking for hidden treasures, and she discovers family traumas while investigating the real reasons behind her dreams.
quote: Always hopeful about everything, Uncle Bilal is the sought-after life coach of our age.

title: Rental Pleasures
logline: After getting casted out of hell, a shape-shifting demon possesses the body of a teenage girl and goes on to explore the many pleasures that has been kept from him.
quote: A celebration to be human.

title: For a Cup of Tea
logline: Mehmet, who forgot his tea plate at his friend's house, learns that his friend gave the tea plate along with many of his belongings to an old dealer when he goes to get it back. Then, he starts a journey to get it back.
quote: If I had experienced this, I would have been among a group of people who joined this journey to find out why Mehmet was looking for his tea plate.

title: Tower of Rosellini
logline: Discovering the Rosellini tower in the excavation area where he was working, Mark starts a research on the rumors that the tower contains information from the future, but what he finds will take him to a place beyond time and space.
quote: Does every step we take forward tear away a piece of the past?

title: Kingdom Undersea
logline: Idris, who got stuck alone in the small station built under the ocean, sees a mermaid tapping on the window to talk to him one day. She will save Idris, but in return, he will be her prince for 100 days in the undersea kingdom.
quote: Idris' transformation into a merman was mesmerizing…

title: Mistakes Anonymous
logline: Fevzi, who regrets many of the decisions he has made in his life, finds people whose lives are ruined as a result of big mistakes they made at some point in their career or private life. He tries to get them all together and form a support group.
quote: Fevzi and his incredible love for these difficult people warmed my heart.

title: Bravement Agreement
logline: When visiting her family, Cansu finds her box in which she hid a piece of her childhood memories and notices that she is very different from the person she thinks she will be when she grows up. At that moment, she promises herself. She will forget about fear and do everything she wanted to do in her life for one day.
quote: It was inspiring to see the panic in Cansu's eyes but watch her still do what she wanted to do.

title: Secret Resistance
logline: High school student Cem, who learns that an inter-dimensional attack will be carried out on the city they live in, is chosen as the first ambassador of the resistance and has two tasks: He must keep the resistance secret and the first person he has to include in the resistance is the person he likes.
quote: Cem's biggest misfortune was that he liked someone who was completely opposite to him.

title: Mr. Satan
logline: When Satan gets used to living an ordinary life among people and resigns from his job, it upsets all the balances in the world. And now the task of restoring the disturbed balance by redistributing evil is left to Emrah, whose body Satan uses.
quote: Necessary evil was a concept that strained the judgment circuits in my brain.

title: Basket of Blueberries
logline: Learning that Yasemin, who has been her friend since she was three years old, has cancer, Zerrin tries to be by her side during the most intense and challenging period of her life.
quote: The stories of meeting in the market and then the ending of the movie in the same market… devastated me…

title: Loveable Demon
logline: A group of friends help a creature that comes out of the bushes suffering from amnesia. However, the creature that slowly begins to remember is actually a demon that has come to haunt them.
quote: I never thought that such a sweet creature could be so terrifying.

title: Long Lasting Heartbreak
logline: A werewolf who has only two months to live until he is fully turned into a wolf wants to fall in love but he has a bad judge of character. And his friend who is actually in love with him is there for him until the end.
quote: It was a torture to watch, anyone who want to cry their heart out can watch this movie.

title: Don't Fall Asleep
logline: Yonca wakes up from a nightmare where she sees her husband dying in traffic accident. But when she starts the day, she realizes that the nightmare has come true. She thinks she is still in a nightmare, but realizes reality and nightmares are endlessly intertwined.
quote: John Wick but the main character fights nightmares instead of bad guys.

title: Fun Fair
logline: A journalist discovers an abandoned amusement park where people are constantly disappearing. When she visits there she finds animatronics that are murdering people and now the next target is herself.
quote: The brilliantly designed hyper-intelligent animatronics vs. the strategist journalist.

title: Birthday Boy
logline: Hakkı, who prefers not to write in his diary for the first time on his birthday, finds himself in endless possibilities and realizes that unless he writes in his diary, the things he experienced that day did not happen. Deciding to experience all the possibilities and choose the best day among them and record it in his diary, Hakkı is unaware of how tiring and challenging this plan would be.
quote: If I don't write in my diary for even a day, my diary would chase me.

title: Compromise
logline: After planning for months for a museum heist, a criminal couple realize they both want different things but the their plan only works if they choose one.
quote: No matter when and where, if there's an argument, everything stops.

title: Witchcraft Bootcamp
logline: A dropout witch trainee sees her teacher after years and learns that there's an evil group of witches terrorizing civilians including her friends and she is the only one who can save them.
quote: If all you can do is to only make a small difference then make a small difference. Every action counts.

title: Accordion
logline: Accordion who wants to save his friends from being destroyed with garbage tries to secretly escape from his house but cannot move without making a sound.
quote: The whole movie felt like a long and incredible symphony.

title: A Friend Request
logline: An old toymaker who can give life to toys can't fulfill a little girl's wish which is to find her a friend. And together they try to make it happen.
quote: If they hadn't figured that they were the cutest BFFs themselves, I would've committed seppuku.

title: Bullet Selim
logline: Selim, whose boyfriend is kidnapped, is forced to return to the assassination he promised himself to quit. However, when he investigates why he was kidnapped, he opens up issues from the past that should not be opened, and the clues lead to his own family...
quote: How well do we actually know people anyways?

title: Who Killed Mr. Alright?
logline: After one of the residents has been killed, a concierge needs to find who killed him before the police arrive because she is one of the suspects as well.
quote: A politician, a rapper, an entrepreneur, an old actor, an activist, and a few tourists. What a fun cast.

title: Energy Conversion
logline: An elastic man gets stuck inside a maze and tries to get out by expanding towards all possible exits but soon he realizes that the maze is constantly changing and his powers are useless against it. All he needs to do now is to be present and think as he goes.
quote: It is a lesson to those who try to do everything at the same time and in the best way…

title: Trace of Future
logline: First murder takes place with the exchange of objects over the phone signals. In the face of this new problem, humanity finds the solution in the partnership of an old-fashioned serial killer and a young hacker.
quote: Silence of the Lambs all over again, but set in the future.

title: Zombie Center
logline: The tax inspector who goes to inspect a ski resort finds himself in a game that has become a tradition. Everyone in the center is acting like a zombie. However, the inspector soon begins to learn that some of the zombies are in fact, real.
quote: Why won't you pay your taxes, Mr. Zombie?

title: One Wish
logline: A desert fairy has until sundown to convince the lost woman that she is real because that day is her last magical day before retiring.
quote: We must never forget to believe in life.

title: Crash Landing
logline: A con artist wants to defraud a major corporate media firm but turns out the firm was looking for someone to put all their blame on for showing fake alien footage as real.
quote: A movie inside a movie inside a movie.

title: Crude
logline: A radio show host in a small town creates a cult following by starting a war against the dark spirit that's affecting everyone.
quote: A war on depression.

title: Elder Wolf
logline: Aunt Fadime, who lives in the Killik kingdom, decides to become a knight at the age of seventy, but learns that it is not easy and it is a goal that takes years. But the war awaiting their kingdom will speed things up.
quote: Long live the Commander Aunt Fadime!

title: Guardian Spirit
logline: Cenk, who came to the ancient city of Herakleia to take pictures, has to spend the night here after missing the bus. However, the spirit that protects the city against grave diggers at night thinks he is also a gravedigger and tries to kill him.
quote: The most unfortunate man of this summer.

title: Delivery
logline: Emrah, the pizza delivery courier has to open up to the customer he likes before he quits the job in three weeks. And together with his best friend Cemre, they begin to come up with the most romantic love story scenarios to act out.
quote: I would've been surprised if there were no exes messing things up.

title: Metal Face
logline: Having started to lose his bet on Earth, Doruk begins to secretly help humanity to stop the conflicts between them, because if he loses the planet-eating Zar will destroy the Earth.
quote: A metal-faced spy aiding mindless people.

title: Bookworms
logline: In a summer night, the library owner tries to prevent the young couple who see each other in the library for the first time to get too close because he senses electricity between them and he just hates love.
quote: The couple trying to make friends instead of enemies was so sweet.

title: Soul Heist
logline: A group of curse-lifters come up with a plan to steal their dying friends' soul before death comes to take it.
quote: A bunch of badass curse-lifters.

title: Master Sadettin
logline: Saadettin, who started to perceive vibrations and frequencies in life as a result of an accident at the gym, gains a new understanding of reality. And he uses this new power to understand and teach life better.
quote: A superhero origin story set in meta modern times.

title: Post-War Generation
logline: Struggling to continue his samurai teachings in the present, Nanashi suddenly finds himself in a post-apocalyptic future where everyone is fighting only with katana, but no one knows who or what samurai is. The only way to go back in history is in the bunker where the leader of the gangsters hide, and Nanashi rolls up his sleeves to reach here.
quote: A samurai in the future.

title: Bound
logline: As a result of a bar fight, the police handcuffs Mümtaz to a radiator so that he won't escape. Things suddenly get out of hand when a big crime organization raids the bar, but Mümtaz does not step back against these two great powers and begins to orchestrate the whole chaos by just speaking from the place where he is handcuffed.
quote: The horror of mind and language…

title: Immovables
logline: Divorced after the age of fifty, Nilüfer decides make a career for the first time but one morning she sees her mother at the door and learns that she has also decided to divorce. While the mother and daughter are living together, they go back and forth between their plans to live life to the fullest, and to make a career.
quote: Mother and daughter, who are constantly bickering but also best friends, warmed the hearts.

title: A Ride in Memories
logline: Making a promise to himself to live a more courageous life, Fuat begins to think about what he would have done if he had been more courageous by remembering all his important memories, but in this process he realizes that what he really needs to do is to stop living in his head.
quote: Imagination is one of humanity's greatest powers, but sometimes it can become a prison.

title: Chemistry Lesson
logline: A chemist teacher encounters one of his students after many years and learns that he is working in an oil company that hurts the planet. So, he tries to convince him to use chemistry to do good.
quote: Just like power, knowledge is dangerous in the wrong hands also.

title: Flower Stories
logline: A bored florist decides to secretly follow his customers to see who they are buying flowers for and learns mysterious things about his neighborhood.
quote: Everyone had their own story to tell.

title: Monsters Inside
logline: A sketchbook comes to life when the owner loses it and it wants to go back to its owner but all the monsters that are drawn inside are trying to get out of the pages and wreak havoc in the city.
quote: A sketchbook with a sense of responsibility saved the day.

title: True Land
logline: In a land where there's no money, one guy wants to trade his way to become a president but he has a very little time left because there's a whole new class system ready to be implemented.
quote: As of the world-building, I've never seen such a thing before.

title: Tucson Forest
logline: A girl who survives in a forest by learning how to throw handmade spears befriends a crow and together they try to get out of the mysterious forest which is full of spells.
quote: Ever-shifting forest with monsters and fairies.

title: The List
logline: Deciding to reach the emotional stability that she has never been able to achieve in her life, Zahter makes a list. But all the things she has to do on the list are also the things she has the worst anxiety about, and she only gives herself twenty days to do all that…
quote: Top of the list is to stop thinking too much about what to eat and drink.

title: Escape from the City Above
logline: The king of the underworld finds himself in prison in the city above and his only chance of getting out is the pickpocket kid who is also there with him. The only problem is that kid doesn't believe in the underworld and doesn't respect him at all…
quote: I would like to live with the perspective of the child who rejects all institutions.

title: Session
logline: After his patient accidentally tells him he wants to kill someone, a psychiatrist has to convince the patient that he won't report it to police but he needs to convince him fast because his friend is on his way to pick him up.
quote: The psychiatrist was professional badass.

title: Tiny Devil
logline: The little demon, who is bad at doing evil, is sent to Earth to intern with the legendary evil Black Demon. But the things he learns from people will lead him to the path of good and he will have to face the most evil and terrible Black Demon himself…
quote: I could've died for the sweet little demon trying to do little sweet evil with his sweet little hands at the beginning of the movie.

title: Secret Paint
logline: After going to paintball game with his friends, a teenager remembers his past life where he was a mercenary in a covert operation and he tries to find out what the operation was about as the paintball game continues.
quote: There were some amazing action sequences as well as it was funny.

title: Testing Ground
logline: Inspecting the perfectly split car on the road, the cops are trying to figure out what might have caused it, but there's one thing they don't realize: aliens are watching and testing humans.
quote: I'm being watched by aliens.

title: Fruits vs Vegetables
logline: Evil fruits are fighting vegetables for people's attention. A good-hearted apple among them is very unhappy with this war and they go together with a tomato to offer peace to the vegetables, but things will not go as easily as they thought. Years of prejudices preclude all solutions.
quote: A political animated film.

title: Sehmus
logline: The musician, who cannot play an instrument after his stroke, finds healing in old shamanic medicines, but this medicine also carries a great curse: the shaman who finds the medicine haunts him.
quote: Long live the Infinite Spirit Shamans Guild

title: Belly Gang
logline: A belly dancer tries to get out of the club but a group of men stalks her. She tells her dancer friends and together they make the lives of the men hell.
quote: A very satisfying story.

title: Two Faces
logline: Elif, who is studying at the infinity school, rebels against the boringness and unnecessary of the lessons and creates a group at the school, but the council of people with eternal life does not accept this behavior because it has very strict rules.
quote: Not being happy when you have everything…

title: Cat Wizard v. Dragon Fighter
logline: A dancer who plays a wizard cat in a costumed performance accidentally picks up real magic supplies for the show and ends up in the fantasy world where he is the cat wizard who has to fight demonic dragon fighter.
quote: Best moment was when the dancer trying to find fake magic items but every supplier think he is a real wizard so giving him real magic supplies.

title: Astral Police
logline: Trying to astral travel to escape her job, Songül is wanted by the police, who thinks that what she is doing is unethical, but Songül has no intention of returning to her boring life and tries to establish a fugitive lifesyyle in this newly discovered world.
quote: Wherever there are people, wars will continue…

title: Boulder
logline: A special agent Musa has a call sign called ‘Boulder’ because he remains chill in every mission but he is tested when he gets an assignment to go to his hometown where all his loved ones are in danger by a terrorist organization.
quote: How can you be life of the party and cold as ice at the same time?

title: Completely Sane
logline: Young entrepreneur Yavuz sells his startup company that makes smart backpacks to the money laundering mafia but his conscience gets the best of him and he gathers a group of entrepreneurs who have weird ideas together to beat the mafia.
quote: Shark Tank with action! My favorite idea was the helicopter toilet paper.

title: Break the Future
logline: In the future where there is a war, an AI soldier that's been built to fight finds itself in wrong hands following unethical orders and develops questioning mechanisms to fight back the bad guys.
quote: Sometimes your biggest enemy is also you.

title: Grandpa Moon
logline: After learning that his granddaughter went missing, a grandfather takes his shotgun that is mounted on the wall and goes after her in the forest. What he encounters there is a magical and very reactive forest and he struggles for a long time whether this is friendly or evil.
quote: I would die for their cute relationship.

title: Find the Snitch
logline: After questioning how the cops learned about the heist so quickly after the robbery, a group of thieves decide that one of them is the informant, but they have little time to find out who this informant is because the police are after them.
quote: It was admirable that they were still trying to find the informant at such a tense moment.

title: Liquor Store
logline: High school friends who want to buy liquor try to rob the market. In doing so, one of them accidentally injures another and they have to call the ambulance but they still won't quit on their plan and try to get the liquor before the ambulance arrives.
quote: The most miserable heist of all time.

title: Naked Eye
logline: The artist, who sits in the same cafe every day and quickly draws the people who come and go, starts to notice a similarity between the people he draws day by day, but as he starts to notice, the people of the city gradually begin to suspect him.
quote: This city is the birthplace of conspiracy theories.

title: Negotiate My End
logline: A person digging up a grave all by herself is visited by two demons who fight over her spirit and she has to calm them down and help them with their decisions.
quote: Think about yourself for once girl!

title: Captivity
logline: When the military moved on from the area, a prisoner who is left behind in a dungeon has to escape before starving to death.
quote: A one man show.

title: UFO Investigator
logline: An unsuccessful private detective decides to make money off of people who believe there are aliens living among us but things get out of hand pretty quickly once the secret cult of the town hires him to investigate the kidnapped girl.
quote: A journey from defraud to corruption all in the name of aliens.

title: Water Gun
logline: Davut accidentally poisons his son as a result of a chemical mixed in the tap water while playing water gun fight, begins his long wait in the hospital with his wife. And in this process, cracks begin to form in their relationship.
quote: The more I saw the scenes showing the origin story of their relationship, the more I cried.

title: Bronze Invasion
logline: A bronze sculpture of the great warrior Lmir comes to live to protect his city from the attack but his own people who live there think this is dark magic and try to stop him.
quote: A political action movie.

title: Trail of Love
logline: A street musician traveling the whole of Europe leaves notes and little presents everywhere he goes for random people but what he doesn't know is that there's a girl surprisingly following the same route for her holiday and she picks up every little thing the musician leaves behind.
quote: Would they meet in the end?

title: Until Dark
logline: An astronaut who hasn't slept for the last 36 hours loses the way to his space shuttle on the Moon and tries to find a way back before he uses all his energy because if he sleeps his oxygen will run out.
quote: An agonizing journey on the deserts of the Moon.

title: The Extinction Land
logline: A woman finds herself in a dimension where only extinct species live and she realizes that humans went extinct also. But she asks why it happened and her curiosity starts the journey of extinct species coming back to the real world.
quote: She just found the recycle bin of the nature in front of our eyes.

title: Fog City
logline: When the city she lives in is in fog for months, Yakut starts investigating why it happened and the clues lead her to a fact that fog was artificial and it all somehow connect to a government corruption. But it won't be easy to win against various lobbyists.
quote: A detective with an environmental cause.

title: Festival Curse
logline: When two friends are trapped inside a festival area, they learn that when the festival is over they will be properly cursed and they have only last two hours until there's no turning back.
quote: The staff who locked and guarded the festival gates had an incredible dilemma.

title: Dark Village
logline: When her son gets lost in the village she travels through, Nat finds out that the village feeds off of children soul to use their dark magic. But they underestimate the power of a mom and Nat is coming after them.
quote: I lost it when she called the power of grandma in the final sequence, it was an exhilarating action combined with bursting emotion.

title: Choreography
logline: In a world where everything moves around within a choreography, Kamil suddenly finds himself outside of this choreography and has to re-engage in it in order to continue his life. However, this will not be as easy as it seems.
quote: Unconscious of this newfound freedom, he tried to get back to being part of the system throughout the movie…

title: Bring Your Mask
logline: A heist plan starts to go south when one of the thieves brings a covid mask instead of a snow mask and forgets the guns at home. So, thieves try to improvise because they have only an hour window to execute the heist.
quote: A group of thieves who hate each other so bad and want the others to get caught.

title: Summer Love
logline: After meeting in holiday and making fun of life together, a girl and a boy promise not to take life seriously. But they won't hear from each other for years and later meet as two serious business people.
quote: Would they reconnect as silly and goofy or not connect again at all?

title: Enchant My Heart
logline: The power of the magical orb is tested when a genuinely unlucky person is brought to the presence of it. He asks to find love but instead of one he finds many.
quote: The endless confusion of bad luck.

title: Kazım, the Data Detective
logline: A data detective notices strange occurrences happening simultaneously in many companies and starts to investigate. This leads him to a being trying to communicate with humans through a digital world.
quote: My brain just couldn't comprehend the vastness of the other dimension and how they live there.

title: Oddparents
logline: Parents decide to stalk their son on his Europe trip but what they don't realize is that it's their son's secret plan the whole time and they have a whole bunch of activities planned for them.
quote: Using paranoia card to plan a perfect holiday for his family, the son is a genius.

title: Photo Box
logline: Finding her childhood photos in the box that disappeared years ago, Nina notices something strange in the photos, as if an evil spirit has taken over her and that evil spirit is now trying to come back.
quote: Alienating yourself and being afraid of yourself, as if I didn't have any other problems, they have been added to my life… thanks.

title: My Beloved Intruder
logline: Offended by his friends, Cevdet makes plans to take revenge on all of them, but Zerrin, whom he met in this journey, is the most positive person in the world and this will make it difficult for Cevdet to stay angry so that he can execute his plan.
quote: Good energies are contagious.

title: Ghost House
logline: When their house is haunted by ghosts, two friends devise many odd plans to get rid of them. Including shadow theatre, acting as if they can command ghosts, telling scary stories about themselves, and many more.
quote: I feel like I watched ghosts haunted by humans instead of the other way around.

title: A Brief Guide to Becoming Evil
logline: A villain story of a girl who wants to rule the world. She plans to own all the money but doesn't know how so she starts to research how to be a criminal.
quote: A coming of age as a villain…

title: I Was Me Before Me
logline: Alara, who suddenly meets her past and future self after a period of intense depression, does not get along with both of them and starts to move forward in life by constantly arguing with them two. But as they try to unravel the cause of this strange phenomenon, all three learn something about themselves and grow.
quote: As someone who constantly complains, I was able to sympathize with Alara.

title: Elevator
logline: Trapped in the elevator he entered on his way to his friend, Yavuz, while waiting to be rescued, thinks about various memories from his life and begins to realize how much he hates his life. Afterwards, he starts to write action plans about what to do in his life after the elevator in his notebook.
quote: He solved years of therapy in one sitting with the elevator.

title: Samurai Killer
logline: A serial killer geisha seduces samurais who brag about their pride and kills them. But word start to get around and everyone wants to find and kill her as a foreigner steps on the land who will eventually be her only supporter.
quote: The foreigner is obviously played by Tom Cruise.

title: Get Back
logline: Two brothers fight over the house after their father passed away but they learn that he donated it to an orphanage because he hates them. Two brothers then, start plotting ways to get the house back.
quote: Turns out their father was right about them all along.

title: Magic Dancing
logline: A witch wants to be a dancer but the dancing group don't like outsiders like her and tries to make her stop coming to their lessons. But the dedicated witch doesn't step down and becomes their nemesis.
quote: I couldn't believe they tried to bully a witch. What were they thinking?

title: Pretty Birds
logline: A group of scientists work on a project to help communicate with the microorganism-sized aliens living now on the Earth's atmosphere but their research center gets raided one day by a group of alien worshippers. Now researchers need to go rogue and continue their projects secretly.
quote: Government workers just watched what has been going on as if they were with me watching the movie with popcorn.

title: Boat Run
logline: Stuck on a boat on an open sea, a group of friends blame each other for what happened but none of them knows what really happened. They just hide from each other.
quote: Even though there's only one place, it is as if we traveled all over the world on that boat and experienced various adventures and more.

title: Whistle
logline: Mesut, who calls a taxi to go to the date on time, throws up in the taxi out of excitement and starts to fight with the taxi driver. Then, mishaps follow him, and his patience is tested by various people all night long until he goes on the date.
quote: At the end of the night, not being able to get up from the rug and get water even though he was thirsty like crazy was like a cherry on top.

title: Chair
logline: Wanting to learn the story of the chair he bought from the junk dealer, Harun dedicates his spare time to start keeping a retrospective diary of the chair. However, what he will learn will take him to places he never knew and even to people who will change his life.
quote: A glimmer of curiosity and a bit of dedication, the magical duo.

title: Master of Life
logline: Necmi who has been scammed by the person who calls himself the master of life waits for him to get out of his hideout for days and in the meantime, he meets with others who had been scammed and he starts to realize a pattern. They all wanted to be fooled because they were unhappy with their life…
quote: I have been fooled by the master of life. It's been an honor.

title: Secret Headphones
logline: Narin, whose headphones suddenly start to connect to other people's phone conversations, can't stop herself from listening to people's private lives even though she feels guilty. She tries to understand human relations, which she has never been able to understand, but what she learns will confuse her even more than enlighten her on this issue.
quote: Watching the movie felt like hearing things you shouldn't be hearing and being where you shouldn't be.

title: Shadow People
logline: Shadow people grant a young boy a wish and he wishes to be successful in saving wildlife from the oil company in his town. But this creates problems among the shadow community since they have been assigned by the oil lord to come there in the first place.
quote: A simple act of kindness goes a long way.

title: Silent Joke
logline: A kid puts a white sheet over his face and tells everyone he is a ghost as a joke. But no one even reacts to him and he starts to realize he has never been loved in his whole life. And he just wants to be a ghost for real…
quote: An epitome of sadness and loneliness.

title: The Castle by the Lake
logline: An architect sits near the lake to study the old castle and as she draws its sketch she notices people inside. And suddenly a young lady kills an a young guy and tries to hide it from the old lady who has been trying to find them…
quote: Rear window but with a haunted castle.

title: This Is How You Start a Riot
logline: A rebellious porcupine meets a scorpion on the way and together they start a riot against humanity but humans wouldn't even notice this since everything happens on a small town in nowhere.
quote: The cutest moment was when the goat was head butting several cars one by one.

title: Jewelry Logs
logline: A detective tries to find the missing jewelry the old lady hired him for but there's a rumor on the street that there have been a series of murder connected to the missing jewelry. The detective tries to steer clear from the murders since he has been tired of many of them in his past but a trail of clues won't allow him.
quote: A detective tries really hard not to uncover the truth.

title: Angelina
logline: Noticing strange behavior in her neighbor while watching out of her window, Lila begins to stalk them and finds out that the woman is cheating on her husband with a woman. She regrets stalking them and tries to forget about it but next day her sister brings that same woman to their house as her girlfriend…
quote: Things just got more and more complicated.

title: Old Flame
logline: After being called to the nursing home for her father's fight with another guy, the daughter meets both of them to settle the argument. Instead she learns the complicated story of how they both met and loved her mother once.
quote: The nicest touch in the story was the fact that they showed the similarities between mother and daughter's love life.

title: Cure for Regret
logline: A scientist who found a cure for hangovers sees a glimpse of the future in his mind where everyone is alcoholic and decides to hide the cure from the public. But words will spread out and creates mayhem in his small town.
quote: The liquor store lobbyists were the happiest.

title: Faceless Monster
logline: Cemre, who got lost on her way to a friend one night, realizes that the roads are constantly changing. She searches for her friends, but she can no longer trust anyone who meets her because there is a creature after her that steals people's faces…
quote: She could neither trust the places she went to nor the people she met… I couldn't breathe while watching it.

title: Wedding in Pictures
logline: A wedding dress salesperson sells a dress that doesn't fit the bride but convinces her otherwise. Then, she gets in trouble because the bride realizes her mistake of trusting her after seeing the comments under her wedding pictures. And she bursts into the shop with many unhappy customers from the past.
quote: The army of brides are so right…

title: Casket Shaped Palette
logline: A high school student wants to investigate why the funeral home in their town has been abandoned for years. As she interviews people for the school journal she hears a lot of horror stories but among them, a thread of reality starts to show and it scares her even more…
quote: The owners of the funeral home had a wild imagination.

title: Top Score
logline: As a result of the murder in the bowling place, all the police in the town camel. But the famous model Tristin fascinates and distracts everyone…
quote: It was very surprising that beauty also interfered with investigations for murder. A complete distraction…

title: Risk Pedal
logline: A couple fights over who would drive back home. Both think they are the better driver but when it's time to really drive the car they both get into traffic anxiety and think they would definitely crash after all this.
quote: I wouldn't think even in my wildest dreams that watching two people in a car just talking for two hours would be this much fun.

title: Diet Police
logline: A seventy years old person is wanted by the police because he claims his special recipes can have a power to alter the sense of taste in people. He starts living life as a fugitive but even this wouldn't stop him from working.
quote: I wish it was real, I want all my salad to taste like fries.

title: Declutter
logline: An artificial intelligence-driven company announces that it will slowly destroy all humans in the world. In the face of this, people cannot come to a common decision and things get more complicated. Meanwhile, people are dying every day…
quote: I don't have the words to describe the whole thing.

title: Flash Night
logline: After eight years on his thirtieth birthday Gentry decides to find what actually happened the day where he got his memory illness. But it would be hard because he loses his memory each night due to the strange phenomenon that happened in the sky that day.
quote: You may be the only witness to an alien visit to Earth but you decide to live with ignorance for years…

title: Murder in the Business Center
logline: After seeing a blood stain on the toilet door, an internee homicide constable needs to lock the whole business center down. The trail of clues points in a direction everyone fears but the intern constable will stop at nothing to find the culprit.
quote: It was very satisfying for the business world to face reality.

title: Looking for a Bestie
logline: A depressed demon wants to be friends with humans but whenever she attempts to meet, people think they are haunted. Meanwhile, a fearless little boy is trying really hard to meet one of the demons from his nightmares. But will they ever meet?
quote: Fearless little guy stole my heart.

title: Party Animal
logline: A spy needs to impersonate a government official at a big party to extract information but there's one obstacle: he has social anxiety.
quote: Sometimes just standing still is stressful.

title: One Ingredient Recipes
logline: An anxiety-driven high-end restaurant chef finds herself in an undeveloped country after her friend dragged her on a holiday. But there without any resources, she learns to love cooking again with the help of locals.
quote: Creativity in absence…

title: The Cousin Galaxy
logline: Douglas who works in the patrol tower at the edge of the galaxy faces lines of aliens everyday trying to get into the Milky Way but then one day, he encounters a human telling him she is from another galaxy. Now, they need to figure out if she is really from another galaxy because no human has ever left the Milky Way.
quote: A future where we patrol around our galaxy. It's a likely one…

title: Betrayal
logline: As the last survivor of the failed mission, Zehra vows to find the rat within the agency. She starts spying on the private lives of everyone in the agency, but after what she learns, she realizes that the agency has never been the place she thought it was...
quote: Wars of interest.

title: Proposed Law
logline: Fuat, who went to prison for supposedly killing someone who is still alive due to a mistake in the law, tries to solve this problem with his lawyer, but the mind-boggling ignorance of the people they face will make things difficult.
quote: I could've punched a hole in the front seat out of frustration watching this.

title: Reflecting Sphere
logline: Zihni, who sees himself in the mirror in his dream, remembers that this should not happen and decides that what he is experiencing is not a dream. Although he starts to make various plans to escape from this new reality, he will begin to lose his sense of time and space after a while.
quote: I kept thinking about it even after it ended.

title: Unsend
logline: A detective who has a hard time finding jobs gets help from her niece and they open a website for him as a digital detective but there is one problem: the detective is bad with technology and tries to solve digital problems in an analog way…
quote: Old and new do not simply fight with each other… They coexist.

title: Stanley
logline: A merman becomes friends with a dog that is visiting the beach every morning and together they formulate a plan for the merman to get back to his ex-girlfriend.
quote: The dog had really dark memories…

title: Dancing Feather
logline: A biologist investigating an elusive feather used in the fashion industry gets frustrated every day because he cannot find the bird it comes from. So he starts looking for answers in the occult and things take a dark turn…
quote: Nobody knows where it comes from.

title: Punk Sparrow
logline: A group of animals run by the fearsome sparrow starts vandalizing a mall and picking fights with humans but soon they realize it's been actually their home the whole time.
quote: Taking revenge on people who have been giving them hell felt so good.

title: Merge
logline: An interior designer notices clues of the family who have lived in the abandoned building she just purchased and wants to discover more but doesn't realize that this story starts affecting her whole reality.
quote: The story of the family was like a psychedelic drug.

title: The Exile King
logline: An immortal king fails to keep his nation alive because of the disease spreading fast among them. Now, alone and lost, he must search the cure for the disease until it destroys another nation but gods have other plans for him.
quote: Walking among them with such great power but no desire to live…

title: The Name of the Passage
logline: Fascinated by the reflections, Joana tries to decipher the message the other world is sending her but the fact is there is no other world…
quote: A completely unique way to looking at our world through the eyes of Joana.

title: Heritage
logline: A daughter of a witch is cursed with knowledge of the hidden emerald and there's no one left to train her as the devil himself is coming to seek it.
quote: I liked how she learned the spells all so wrong but made them even more effective in her own way.

title: Necmettin the Pipe
logline: Necmettin, who is afraid of leaving the house, follows everything that happens in his neighborhood as a hobby. One day, when he learns that the daughter of one of his neighbors has disappeared, he tries to find the girl by recreating everything he has learned in the last days in his mind.
quote: It was like a modern Rear Window movie.

title: I'm Your Guy
logline: Araz's conversation with his dying friend takes him on a journey because his friend wants to meet an old wise dragon. Although it seems impossible, Araz begins to discover new things that are visible in the world, but that we always overlook, in order to fulfill this wish of his friend. But his friend does not have much time…
quote: It was as sad a story as it was fascinating.

title: Night Eagles
logline: Denisse goes to the police station as witness to the incident she saw at the restaurant. After waiting for the whole day, she gets interrogated as a murder suspect. Her lawyer says that there has been a mistake and that he will solve the problem within 24 hours, but the room where she will spend this time doesn't seem like a safe place…
quote: The entire movie took place in only three locations, the waiting room, the interrogation room, and the detention room, and it reflected the protagonist's feeling of being stuck.

title: Protocol
logline: Working in the interplanetary transport business, Nas begins to drift off course due to an error in his vehicle. He remembers that he has a colleague who will meet his route in a few months, but there is a problem. The company's protocol in case of possible drift is to destroy everything on the spacecraft, along with the employee...
quote: The system responsible for destruction was of course an artificial intelligence that was extremely difficult to shut down…

title: Her Will
logline: Hannah writes her ashes to be sold in her will and after she dies of cancer, her boyfriend has to complete the task. But this puts her boyfriend into a challenging situation where he must make many decisions that are against societal norms.
quote: It forced me to think against all my usual instincts.

title: The Book of Gerald
logline: An ancient spirit starts visiting Nile in her dreams and teaches her the ways of the Wiccan. Because ancient relics have been surfaced and she needs to keep them away from the wrong hands which are many…
quote: Dream sequences were wild when the bad guys entered it to fight the ancient spirit.

title: Wheels of Fortune
logline: While on tracking Tuna finds a cave and goes in. She sees lots of writings on the wall and realizes it's a cry for help. This makes her to discover lots of different worlds until he finds out who is in trouble.
quote: Journey through different perceptions were trippy.

title: Infest
logline: Rachel and Ursula, who accidentally book a haunted hotel for vacation, have to cooperate to escape from the hotel, but this will not be so easy due to the cracks in their relationship and their constant arguments.
quote: Sometimes I forgot about all the horror elements and wanted them to figure their shit out.

title: Lie Research
logline: After his uncle killed his aunt, Tolga, who started to investigate the origins of his family, finds more than ten generations from all over the world and realizes that similar murders have occurred in each of them. In fact, this little research he started for his escape from what he went through will confront him with a problem that has been going on for generations as well as himself.
quote: It was very sad that every generation had a Tolga and none could solve the obvious problem because of their personal problems…

title: Stem
logline: A stammering child is forced by her teacher to become a motivational speaker. Instead, she stops talking all together and slowly starts seeing delusions.
quote: Alicia v. her delusions.

title: Admiral of Fleeting Charism
logline: Working in an office full of trickster beings always messing with humans, Urao decides to be friends with one of them and the human teaches him a lot about how humans associate with reality.
quote: Spending ordinary moments with these extraordinary characters and ideas gave me a lot to think about life.

title: Custody Wars
logline: Annette and Fred decide to get a divorce after years of an unhappy marriage but they don't want their little boy to be affected from it. So, they act as if the divorce and the whole process is part of a game. But it won't be as easy as they thought because they need to collaborate perfectly which they can never do.
quote: I appreciated their commitment.

title: Coloring Book
logline: Little Nilay, who fills her coloring book with various colors, suddenly realizes that everything in her field of vision can change its color.
