Shee thinks that a mysterious fairy gave her this power and tries to tell everyone about this fairy. However, no one around her will be able to see these magical details of the world.
quote: Little Nilay just wanted to be accepted…

title: Computer Password
logline: High school student Taylan, who wants to steal a computer from the library, develops a plan with his friends that will look like bank robberies. But on the same night as they put the plan into action, they find someone else breaking into the library to steal a book, and things get complicated.
quote: A thief with style was tidying the shelves while he was stealing the books…

title: Pending Change
logline: Pınar, whose new plant is dying, cannot bring the plant back to life no matter what she tries. Due to her stubborn personality, she continues until the last moment, but what happens will lead her to confront her past, which goes back to the death of her mother.
quote: A beautiful harmony that starts off calm and progresses to a great frenzy.

title: Routine That Kills
logline: Rahmi, who has not been able to sleep for days, loses the grip on where reality begins and ends. While trying to solve this, he will realize that this has actually given a new perspective to his boring life.
quote: We witnessed a fantastic world in Rahmi's insomnia frenzy…

title: Fatal Stories
logline: Siniestra gets entrapped in his friends stories as they tell the most scariest moments of their lives and this become a never ending nightmare for him. In order to get out of this situation he must face his most scary moment…
quote: I felt like I was watching five horror movies at once.

title: Assassination
logline: An assassin wants to escape his training place, but he can't turn this into reality because he knows them as his family. One day, he makes a deal with himself to sever his ties with these people over time. The only problem is that he has to keep killing people for business during this time.
quote: The chaotic relationship between will and conscience.

title: Directory
logline: A group of children enters an abandoned building in a remote corner of the park where they are playing. However, when they enter, the door closes on them and they fear that each of their nightmares will come true.
quote: We actually create our own worst nightmares…

title: Next Job
logline: A spy starts a scenario in his mind that his crew mate would betray him in the next job. He starts questioning everything during the subsequent operation resulting in a catastrophe in their hands.
quote: Started as a psychological thriller and quickly turned into a Michael Bay mayhem.

title: History of a Book
logline: Someone leaves a book in a community center and random people start picking it up and putting it back after a few days. A kid notices this and contemplates reading it but he wants to see how long when this will keep going. What he doesn't know is that people who read the book are also observing the kid.
quote: Both the test subject and observers. Until they are not.

title: Mystery Call
logline: When a mysterious caller starts giving her directions about how to get the boy she likes, Irma thinks the caller is actually the guy she likes. It turns out that he was the guy who she hates the most. At least she used to hate him so much but now…
quote: A blanket of sweet confusion.

title: Bet on Life
logline: Friends who find the elixir of life makes a bet on who would regret it the most. They come up with a system to evaluate what is more important in life and what is not which eventually becomes a well-known guide on how to live a better life.
quote: So in the end they found a way not to regret it.

title: Risky Fate
logline: After his commissioner has been killed, an undercover cop must survive in a world of crime but instead of quitting and running away he starts to get ambitious.
quote: I was amazed by what was happening after he started getting ambitious.

title: Me Game
logline: A person wakes up one day not remembering anything about his life and finds an address in his pocket but one way or another he cannot go to the address. Because lots of people come up to him on his journey calling him different names and asking for his help on some stuff. Would he be able to get to the address?
quote: This was one trippy journey, my mind feels like it just ran a marathon.

title: Knight of Sandwell
logline: A young knight challenges the prince to a duel and kills him in front of the king, which gets him executed. But the gods bring both the prince and the young knight back to life so they can fight forever as the kingdom's protectors. The problem is, both of them now hate the kingdom…
quote: It looks like a big fantasy story, but there were real character development scenes.

title: High Decision
logline: Defne climbs on a tree to think one day. People start noticing her and ask why but they won't be satisfied with the answer. They try to bring her down. However, Defne does not agree to go down because she still cannot make a decision about the subject she is considering, and things get more and more complicated.
quote: I kept going back and forth between getting angry at why they were interfering with Defne's decision and being angry that it was never clear what Defne was thinking.

title: Wish Witches
logline: A bank robber meets a witch one day and wishes for better skills to use robbing instead his whole look changes completely making him a hot guy. This sets him on a journey to not care what people think about him.
quote: Even the bank thief is reaching inner calm while I can't decide what the next song should be here.

title: Silver Visit
logline: Silver always wanted to be a serial killer but she couldn't bring herself to take anyone's life. On her twenty-first birthday she comes up with a plan for the police to notice her: she will place clues around other murders so they will look as if she killed all of them.
quote: Weirdest coming of age movie ever, but also somehow the cutest…

title: Abandoned Sword
logline: A warrior takes an oath to avenge his fallen friend and inscribes this on his sword, giving it magical features that put his enemy weak against it. So, he starts toying with the enemy, and soon he begins wondering what revenge means…
quote: I started the movie for action and ended by questioning life.

title: Actually Not There
logline: The detective, who will die if he communicates with his partner, is working to find the serial killer who caused it, but his partner is determined not to leave him alone in this investigation. In the process, the detective has to ignore his partner until the murderer is revealed.
quote: It was an interesting experience from start to finish.

title: Rogue Machine Assassins
logline: Trapped in a company of rogue machine assassins, Rune needs to learn how to act like them until she finds what she seeks. What she doesn't know yet is that machines also look for the same thing: her ancestors who built the machine assassins…
quote: Imagine borning with a purpose and with things you cannot change, it would've driven me crazy as well.

title: Silence Beyond
logline: The best warrior of the emperor Hin is the subject of a bet between royals. He is to go into the land of demons and bring the ‘Pearl of Whisperers’ which can end the war that's been going on for centuries. But he needs to embark on this journey without his physical might.
quote: Forget everything you know about fantasy stories…

title: Thieves Searching for Thieves
logline: The corporation of thieves is threatened since more than one group claims they robbed the central bank. So, they hire a professional detective to find out who did it before the police do it. But the police hired a professional detective also.
quote: I missed watching these stylistic crime movies…

title: Curious Chap
logline: Nichol who lives in a nursing home sees an ad one day that says “win this game and gain magical powers.” Immediately he is thrust into a world of a fantasy game but realizes that the makers of the game haven't designed this game for old people. But this doesn't stop him and he starts making progress with his strategist mind.
quote: Wisdom beats it all.

title: Separate Stories
logline: They haven't met yet. The only thing connecting them is their longing for finding the other. Life and other people get in the way of them coming together. In the meantime, they have a task to become full as individuals and not dependent on anyone…
quote: Modern-day love story that is asking correct questions.

title: My Eagle Friend
logline: An eagle flies right through Nolan's window and he sees that it's hurt but he must hide it from his family since they would say it's dangerous and take it to a veterinary. In the meantime, eagle becomes his best friend but knows he will have to say goodbye one day.
quote: A dangerously cute friendship.

title: Ancient Language of Things
logline: After a pocket watch calls for him in the flea market, Rick suddenly starts understanding the language of objects but not just any objects only the really old ones. They call for him because these old objects need Rick's help in fighting the new objects and taking down the massive factory in their town.
quote: Technology vs. experiences and memories.

title: Earliest Memory
logline: A socially awkward marine biologist has to navigate a lot of political and ethical issues of her project in order to save the habitat in the dying lake she grew up nearby.
quote: Bright people against harsh reality.

title: Night Stories
logline: After days of depression, Zerrin, who wants to get up and at least tidy up her kitchen, accidentally drops a knife on her foot and has to go to the hospital late at night. As the room was becoming a prison for her because of the compulsive talker old woman, after a while Zerrin starts to learn lessons about herself from the stories told by the woman.
quote: I suspect that the old woman was actually Zerrin from the future.

title: Identity Is Dead
logline: Realizing that his identity has turned into a prison for himself, Noya decides to leave behind the personalities he created to continue his life, but in the process, his family and friends will not understand Noya's inner journey…
quote: I couldn't have imagined an actor playing so many characters… and lack of characters.

title: To Catch a Knife
logline: An old tale in the kingdom says there's a hidden dagger somewhere that has unimaginable magical powers, and all the warriors search and even kill for it. But one youngling among them secretly tries really hard for it not to be found. Because he experienced the curse that comes with it.
quote: One against the whole kingdom… such strong will…

title: Thought of Being Eaten Alive
logline: After their ship sank, Annette finds herself on a little island that has been separated from the land by a river but she cannot cross it because there are lots of crocodiles which are waiting for her. Which one will she choose, dying of thirst or taking a risk of being eaten alive?
quote: I wasn't ready for this story to be asking deep questions…

title: Piercing Blow
logline: Trapped in a drifting space shuttle, Rath tries to send a signal to Earth but first, she must stop her teammate from killing her and then himself because he has lost his mind.
quote: The whole movie being in complete silence just added to the intensity of it…

title: My Suit Enemy
logline: A Rembrandt painting has been stolen from the city museum and a secret agent is tasked to find it. His best attribute as an agent is the suit he is wearing which is programmed to protect the person wearing it. But him being the most clumsy person on earth sets everything into a glorious catastrophe.
quote: Hilarious performance both by the actor and by the suit.

title: Tenant
logline: A group of experienced thieves comes together as they try to find a way to steal a chandelier that is owned by one of their moms because she has been having a hard time with her tenant. But the tenant's house is more protected than any place they have ever broken into.
quote: Home Alone meets Ocean's 11.

title: Johnny Scream
logline: A work-at-home voice actor for cartoons becomes a shared complaint among other tenants at the apartment because he screams too much but one of their kids starts convincing all the tenants to stop complaining by telling them what type of character he dubs in the cartoon.
quote: The friendship between the voice actor and the kid was heartwarming.

title: Demon Neighbor
logline: Grandma, who turned the demon that haunts their neighborhood to her side, becomes a target of three new demons sent for support. However, the demon who has changed sides will protect the grandmother against the new demons, along with the grandchild it has trained to fight.
quote: The scenes where grandma sending the demon to run errands for the neighborhood were hilarious.

title: Fan Boy
logline: A plastic fan that manipulates time falls into the hands of a whistleblower but instead of preventing ugly corruption from happening in the company by manipulating time, he decides to advantage of the situation and repeatedly sell the delicate information.
quote: A cautionary tale of how even the clearest waters can be easily polluted.

title: Street Light
logline: A high-profile jewelry thief starts to steal distinctive street lights around the world just to keep himself engaged but this sets in motion a whole other chain of events that may cure his depression.
quote: Larger than life characters with their relatable problems…

title: Chopstick and a Shovel
logline: A local chef starts digging up graves at night to make a “sauce” to serve people in his restaurants but an internationally famous detective gets a whiff of this and starts to investigate against all questioning on his decision.
quote: You're the most famous investigator with the greatest track record but people still judge your decisions.

title: Memory Enhancement Center
logline: Zach wants to remember all the good and bad things, cherish them, and learn from them. So, he signs up for a memory enhancement center but remembering everything won't be as he imagined. It will ultimately turn into a nightmare…
quote: Series of bad decisions.

title: The Secret History
logline: Belling keeps dying and waking up in another century without a reason but one day after heavy rainfall near a cemetery he learns from a stranger that he has been cursed to travel through centuries but he doesn't remember why. This sets him on a journey where he tries to learn who cursed him.
quote: Affecting the whole history of humankind while searching for self.

title: Fly on the Wall
logline: Zehir who lives by picking up trash starts to notice stories unraveling in her neighborhood by reading what has been thrown out. In the beginning, she yearns for people's lives but as time passes she learns the true nature of people.
quote: What's sad and what's happy are only in our perception.

title: One Vote
logline: A journalist starts to investigate the personal life of the politician who has been making very bad decisions lately and at first it seems that politician is only doing it for attention but as the journalist digs deeper he learns that the politician is lonely…
quote: We watched a detective examine a person's mood.

title: Fake Ambition
logline: John who always lives under the shadow of his neighbors son, wants to beat him once in his life and starts training to be an astronaut but the training seems to be too harsh on him and he gives up. One problem is that his trainer hasn't given up on him.
quote: It was very sad that his coach had gone through similar things.

title: Neighborhood Orchestra
logline: A trumpet player tries to get into the local orchestra but they won't accept his applications because she is not a “culture fit”. When she meets the musicians outside she thinks they get along really well but learns that the real obstacle is the owner of the place.
quote: Always the old white guy running things.

title: Painted Lives
logline: Joseph, who is known for his unorthodox paintings of naked boys, gets assigned to paint the new chapel but he decides that he will hide cryptic messages in the paintings telling all kinds of scandalous information about renaissance life.
quote: True face of the renaissance lifestyle.

title: How to Kidnap Your Neighbors
logline: After getting assigned to abduct a scientist couple, an alien named Juon transforms her body into a human and rents the house next door to them. But as she learns about the couple and the human way of living she starts hesitating about her assignment…
quote: The day at the aquarium was the best day of that alien's life.

title: Forbidden Language
logline: Giorgio accidentally summons a demon while trying to read ancient relics. As the demon hunts him down, he discovers a forgotten language that can summon the dead and even use black magic. So, he decides to learn the language, make the demon obey him, be the master of black magic and rule the world.
quote: He suffered so much, I wanted him to achieve all his goals.

title: Cruise Shop
logline: On a cruise ship, a girl is missing. There are three different gangs claiming they have her and asking for ransom from her rich parents but after a while, crime gangs start fighting each other. Orchestrating behind all these are the parents who are actually secret agents.
quote: When they cut to the little girl every time crazy shit happen was hilarious.

title: Infinity Box
logline: Rume invents a box that simulates infinity but the government gets in on the action quickly and forbids him or anyone else from opening it. This makes scientists start arguing about the probability of the box being real. Markets start betting on it. The box wreaks havoc on the whole world giving Rume only two options; open it or destroy it.
quote: This escalated quickly.

title: Paper Print Man
logline: The quest to find the serial killer who calls himself the paper man reaches even to the local private investigators when there's a bounty involved and one awful detective is the perfect guy for the job.
quote: Their standout was glorious…

title: A Bet on Pizza
logline: John wants to find a rival and excel in competition to be successful in life. But there's a problem, he doesn't know what to do with his life. His mom urges him to find something he likes to do instead but he goes out to search for competition-worthy people in any area and test himself…
quote: I felt like I was playing with all kinds of toys in an amusement park.

title: Detective Zayn
logline: A suicidal detective tries really hard to find one villain who would kill him but the bad guys always do a poor job of acting out their evil plans. This makes the detective extremely popular and he hates it…
quote: When you lose all fear you involuntarily become successful in everything.

title: Virtual Made
logline: A group of children wants to discover the building that was left unfinished and as soon as they enter the area they step into the virtual reality the architect created. They find out that the architect wants to believe in this virtual reality because of his fears so the children need to convince him of going back where he can finish his work.
quote: Their way of coming up with solutions and delegating them inside the group was a pleasure to see.

title: Ghost Stalker
logline: George is curious about the story of the new person in town but he learns about spooky instances where he stalked people at night. One day, the guy starts stalking George and when he asks why the guy says there's a ghost following George around so the guy wants to get rid of it.
quote: The guy was practically a ghost hunter and George was more interested in him than the ghost.

title: Bet/Off
logline: Two friends keep complaining to each other about how one overthinks and another one just acts without thinking. Then, one day they decide to switch roles for an entire week but their lives change drastically. One becomes a nightmare and the other one a comedy. Let's see which is which…
quote: I admired their commitment.

title: Slip
logline: Two newly recruited detectives bust a wrong shipping at the dock and detain innocent people. The whole thing becomes a nightmare after one of them sue the police department first for psychological damage and then kill himself.
quote: It was a whirlwind of emotions.

title: Dream Quest
logline: Henry thinks the reality he has been experiencing lately is not real and he suspects that he is stuck in someone else's imaginary world where delusions wreak havoc. In order to get out of this situation, he starts investigating who the imaginary world belongs to but as he learns more he starts questioning his existence.
quote: Twist after twist made me even question my own existence.

title: Book of Infinity
logline: Ravi, who the weight of existence has crushed, goes into a library one day to find a good book to read, but as soon as he enters the building, his surroundings change. A librarian comes up to him and explains that it's a library with an infinite book and the only way he can get out of this is to find the book with an answer. But he can only summon books if he knows the title and the author.
quote: It was like trying to solve a math equation.

title: Brainwash
logline: Neil who is angry all the time wants to get hypnotized to change some of his habits. He makes a deal with a shady guy who promises him that he can hypnotize him but only with a painstakingly hard and physical process. And this challenges Neil to rethink his desires in life as he goes through all the practices.
quote: He reversed Rocky-ied himself and in the meantime reevaluated everything.

title: Subto Express
logline: A hired killer who is addicted to stressful situations keeps trying to find more impossible tasks for herself but on her latest target in the Subto train, she gets challenged by the most risk-avoidant detective.
quote: She milked even the last drop of tension between them while toying around with the detective.

title: Secret Accounting Society
logline: Necmi who has been poor his whole life finds an invitation to one of the events of a mysterious company and gets introduced to the secret society of accounters who dominate where the money goes in the world. And he decides to infiltrate society and fight it from the inside.
quote: Necmi vs. the whole system.

title: Patch
logline: A musician who is a test subject in a neuroscience experiment starts feeling strange sensations and one day he realizes they have been using his body at night to do illegal work. So, he starts investigating and finds that if he keeps improvising his life he can outrun the commands in his mind.
quote: A scary portray of medicine and health in the future.

title: Copana
logline: A secret service agent who is charismatic and very good at his job chases an underground criminal leader to a small city called Copana but there he finds Copana doesn't need his help, locals start chasing the criminal leader themselves and they even do a better job.
quote: They basically told him that he is not the main character anymore.

title: Heirloom
logline: A book of dark spells has emerged after being lost for centuries, dark wizards from all across the world are trying to acquire it but the girl who actually has it has no clue what it is. She thinks it's just an antique her grandmother left her. In reality, she must become the protector of it…
quote: Poor girl had to live through it all to learn everything about her past.

title: Dailies
logline: Old man Nick who can die any second because of his illness starts complaining about having second-guessed everything in his life while living but his granddaughter challenges this idea with daily tasks and games she brings to him.
quote: I suppose stubbornness and grumpiness run in the family.

title: Space Meat
logline: A group of astronomers discovers ginormous alien animals living on a planet far away and they want to try to understand if they have consciousness or not as humans do. But first, they need to deal with the reality of the world. How are they going to share this with the public and what would officials do with this information.
quote: Criticizing the state of human species.

title: Hippodrome
logline: Naru starts investigating the secret society of bettors and finds out that they have been making mysterious creatures race in a hippodrome. She comes up with a plan to free the creatures and on this journey, she learns a lot about where they come from.
quote: It was like an investigation of a cult.

title: Pumpkins and Bats
logline: Burak's imaginary world has a committee of decision-makers who are three little pumpkins. During the Halloween season, they take over his body with the help of many bats responsible for his mood. Together, they orchestrate the scariest Halloween for him as if they are all too real. But are they harmless? We have yet to decide…
quote: It was a celebration of scares.

title: Ghost Crawl
logline: Five ghosts who don't remember how their lives were come up with a plan to find out their pasts. They gather the places they remember and together they visit each place one by one scaring people away. In the process, they start to remember, but what they find out is even scarier…
quote: I have never seen on the screen where a ghost lost his shit.

title: Car Cloud
logline: People live their lives in their transport; a car, a truck, or even a ship. They are part of our bodies. Marcus, who drives a gray sedan, sees a person outside of his car one day. He thinks it's a dream but this sparks curiosity in him and he starts to discover his own body and the intricacies of their society.
quote: This was one of the creepiest dystopias.

title: The Wizard Dietician
logline: The wizard who is known to be the greatest sorcerer of his generation gets impressed and influenced by humans and starts living with their ways. But his decision to become a dietician brings the downfall of society as they know it. He starts his series of spells with midnight eating. Food people eat turn into spiders in their stomach…
quote: This was hilariously gore and surprisingly uplifting…

title: Inkcollar
logline: After getting injected nanobots into her skin while getting a tattoo, Naru notices strange differences in her behavior. Then one day, she finds herself next to the founder of a massive company and suddenly kills him. At that moment her suspicions become real and she tries to find the tattoo artist before the police find her.
quote: This was filled with non-stop adrenaline like the movie Crank…

title: Passageways of Time
logline: Sari comes upon an article written as if it's eighty years further into the future. At first glance, she thinks it's a typo but she starts searching for the terms mentioned in the paper and cannot find any explanation online. So, she starts an investigation on the writer but this takes her into an unexpected path.
quote: They should award her for the investigative journalist work she did about five centuries.

title: Paper Mache Evil
logline: Chantelle's drawings come alive after her mom tells her to put them under her bed at night. What her mom doesn't know is that the characters she drew were evil and Chantelle invited them into their houses. So, she needs to set this right and send the characters back to where they belong before her mom finds out. In doing so, she learns the true nature of her family and learns to cast her first spell.
quote: This girl is either going to be the biggest calamity of the world or the biggest gift to the world.

title: In Search of Dragons
logline: Joel wants to find where dragon stories originate. Hence, he starts by traveling to the Mesopotamia region to study but what he doesn't know is that there are some people who make money from these mystical stories and they will not be happy when their business is disturbed…
quote: Although there was nothing mystical or magical to it, the story felt like a fantasy tale and I loved it.

title: Small Talk Detective
logline: Inspector Lemon's method of small talking his way around the neighborhood until he finds the killer is not approved by the squad since he solves all the cases. This forces the commissioner to assign him to another town where people would not be comfortable with him. So, Lemon needs to first earn the people's trust so that he can start solving cases again.
quote: I didn't even realize he was solving the case until he solved it.

title: Cursed Watch
logline: Marvin vows to break the curse of his late father's watch so he starts wearing it every day. The next day his friend gets into an accident and a week after his girlfriend breaks up with him. But his stubborn nature doesn't allow him to take the watch off and in time he understands that watch didn't cause any of it but rather his perception of it did. And he starts understanding his late father's life better…
quote: A study that underlines the power of the mind.

title: Peeler's Forest
logline: After her friend disappeared in the forest, Nella decides to go look for her. On her way, she starts remembering about all the horror stories about a person living in the forest who skins people alive.
quote: An eerie journey into the forest for ninety minutes…

title: Datebook
logline: Nimburg keeps a journal of date ideas to get ready for the days when he will have a girlfriend finally, but as time passes without any chance with anyone he starts feeling pathetic. Then one day, he decides to make his ideas happen by dating himself. So, his search for the other turns into finding himself in the process…
quote: A romantic story about loving yourself.

title: High School Detectives
logline: A group of friends in high school wants to win the mystery-solving competition, but on the day of the finals, a stranger gets involved in the team because they can't say no, which changes the whole dynamic. The rules say they cannot exclude the new guy since they have already started competing. So now, they need to readjust to win while arguing about the whole thing…
quote: Sometimes being nice is a curse.

title: Ego Cup
logline: A cup holds the power of realizing its drinker's biggest ambitions but this gift comes with a price. It boosts the drinker's ego and turns him or her into a monster. And one day the cup falls into the hands of an ambitious salesperson whose goal is to win it all…
quote: His ambition to win all was a sight to behold.

title: The Wood Nymph
logline: A wood nymph accompanies little Meg on her journey to find her mother. On the way, however, the nymph tries to understand why she is trying to find her mother, who abandoned her years ago.
quote: I didn't expect Meg's family would be connected to the whole forest myth.

title: Exchange of Appearances
logline: Seeing that the appearance of people he knows changes with the appearance of others, Zayn rushes home and sees himself transformed into someone else in the mirror. While trying to figure out why this interesting phenomenon has occurred, he begins to realize that he has always built his life around others until that day.
quote: The irony of being the only person who changes the world because of his wish while also becoming the only one who is realizing it.

title: Little Heist
logline: After being grounded for a week in the orphanage they live in, George and his best friend Jules devise a plan to steal the keys from the headmaster's office to buy the limited edition lego set before it's sold out.
quote: I'm sure they are the children's version of Danny and Rusty from Oceans movies.

title: Helping Hand
logline: Nilay saves Caner who stumbles while walking on the road from falling, and she realizes that the person in front of her is a person who has given up expectations from life. She decides to walk with him and help him. However, this whole process also brings questions about her own life to the surface again…
quote: Caner was a black hole that kept on devouring.

title: The War Within Me
logline: Realizing that his life is overwhelmed by the decisions he has made so far, Blake wants to make new decisions to change everything, but has no idea where his new life will lead. That's why he hesitates to make decisions. Will Blake be able to reinvent himself in this war initiated by his fears and desires?
quote: You can't win the game before going on the field… He just had to take that one step forward.

title: Broadcast Hysteria
logline: After a local radio station starts broadcasting weird noises that caused hysteria among the listeners, a city detective gets assigned to come to the town and investigate it. On the very first days, he notices that the whole town is voluntarily in on this but what he doesn't know yet is that these noises affected the whole nation and now the people behind it are starting to control them.
quote: How to understand big things looking from small scales.

title: Twelve
logline: Twelve days remaining on the launch, an astronaut starts following his intuitions in life to understand his own soul. But the tedious nature and the seriousness of the tasks at hand keep snapping him back to reality. Will he risk it all or balance both sides perfectly.
quote: A study on comparing concrete action against inspiration.

title: The Curse of the Lighthouse
logline: A lighthouse keeper hears that a pirate ship is approaching in a few weeks to attack the lighthouse but the keeper decides that he will not allow them. So, he starts setting up the whole area for artificial horror stories to scare them off and he sets up props to back it up. Now, all he needs to do is wait…
quote: He was a dedicated fella utilizing the power of storytelling.

title: My Contender
logline: A design competition with scrap materials between young architects turns into a flirty dance between two contenders. And the competition also picks up as they come face-to-face with each other in the final.
quote: The thrill of getting to know someone you know in the most intense environment.

title: Costume Inspection
logline: After a fun night of a costume party, Neil wakes up to see a gorilla costume walking around without a human in it and together they try to find the person who wore it the night before. But the thing is party went a little crazy at some point so Neil doesn't know everyone who came.
quote: Hearing the neighbors costume stories was a lot of fun.

title: Pillow Portal
logline: A group of kids realizes their pillow forts are somehow connected and you can travel through between other forts. They vote to keep this a secret among them but one kid thinks they should inform scientists about it and they start arguing about what to do with it. These arguments paralyze them for weeks and they cannot do anything with it until one day the portals disappear…
quote: Introducing kids with harsh truths.

title: Starved Mind
logline: Starving Luna takes refuge in an abandoned house on her way but finds that the fridge is full of plastic food. Then, she starts thinking maybe she is hallucinating them as plastic but in fact, they are real because she has been on the road for weeks. And this would be the beginning of her frenzy…
quote: An incredible one-person performance.

title: Underground Network
logline: A lonely porcupine lost in a big city falls into the sewer and there he meets mice that are on the run from mouse police. Together they start having an outlaw life while learning the hidden sides of the city.
quote: It was so cute how Henry the mouse wrapped him in a blanket just to hug him.

title: Hidden Section
logline: An engineer opens the blueprints of the starship they have been building for a quick chat. And he realizes there are secret compartments in the ship. He starts to investigate who added them and this leads him to the real secret mission of the starship.
quote: Unraveling the truth about the future.

title: Point of View Man
logline: After a sudden heart attack, a lawyer starts to see other people's points of view at will. First, he starts using this phenomenon to win cases but after a few instances the power begins to corrupt him and he loses his sense of self. So now, he needs to find a way to get back to himself.
quote: It was hard to see how limited our perception is…

title: Newest Sensation
logline: As Buket's Parkinson's disease worsens day by day she notices she's been captivated by a feeling that she doesn't recognize. So, she starts to investigate where the feeling originates with her new neighbor who always seemed so nosey and irritated for her until that day.
quote: We're always in search of a human connection.

title: Agent of the Mind
logline: A rogue agent wants to expose the secret service he worked for but one day taking the train to another city he notices there are many agents surrounding him. But their objectives seem like they are trying to convince him. The agent decides he will assume everyone on the train are agent and try to get through the last two hours of his trip without losing his mind.
quote: Let the mind games begin.

title: 12 Days of Crypto
logline: A group of thieves manages to steal billions of dollars of crypto coins but the next day the new government policy renders them all useless. So, thieves plan to hijack the prime minister's private plane so they can revert the policy. But what they don't realize is that the private plane's pilot is an ex-military official, so he makes everything hard for them.
quote: They were taking it to another level and then it went even beyond…

title: Remote Life
logline: As a protest to rising house prices in the city, Nadir buys a castle on a remote island and starts building his life there. But islanders start performing religious rituals around the castle resulting weird happenings inside the castle…
quote: I would've still lived there. A crowded city is the worst nightmare.

title: Speck
logline: A speck of dust who has an existential crisis wants to understand why they do what they do as a dust society. She tries to find a way to communicate with a human who is having similar problems but the dust nature of not being able to control their surroundings would be the greatest challenge ahead of her.
quote: Ambition moves beyond the known space and time…

title: Wait a Minute
logline: April's life has fallen apart. She got fired from her job, broke up with her boyfriend, lost her favorite aunt, and now she has acne on her forehead. Then, one day just as she goes out to get coffee like everyday she meets Jones who is dedicated to get in her life with a full force. But before meeting him she decided to fix her relationship with herself before moving on to anything…
quote: We don't need anyone else to feel complete.

title: Diary Imposter
logline: A notorious trickster wants to retire from a world of crime and moves into a rural town but here he gets bored and starts creating fake diaries in the name of people around him causing a disruption in the community.
quote: Greatest prank of all time.

title: A Step Backwards
logline: Another dimensional being wants to make an experiment and chooses planet Earth as its subject. The experiment would turn time backward but humans experience it as an illness and think there's some mysterious disease that makes people become mindless apes. But a group of scientists sees beyond this and they try to get out of the experiment somehow…
quote: How to get out of this snow globe that is called Earth?

title: An Island of Ever-Changing Maze
logline: Rex distorts reality every time he sneezes and turns his surroundings into a maze. At least that's what he thinks until a magic investigator helps him unravel the curse on his mind. But to get rid of it they will need to find who put on the curse and why.
quote: Sometimes I wonder if I have a navigation curse also…

title: Dinner with Friends
logline: A group of friends begins to understand the background of the intrigues going on in the neighborhood, as each of them shares their own knowledge about people in the neighborhood. As the pieces of the puzzle come together, they begin to think that they might find out who is behind the murder that was committed only a week ago.
quote: 12 hungry men.

title: Corner Shop of Mystic
logline: Cüneyt realizes the shop around the corner is a gateway to mystical lands and starts secretly observing who is going in and out but quickly realizes it's not about what's going on inside the worlds but more about who is coming out from them to invade their world and why.
quote: Grass is always greener on the other side.

title: Say “Ghost!” at Eleven
logline: The ghost who only turns up at 11 pm to say goodnight becomes a laughingstock of the people who know about him but one kid in the neighborhood decides to learn more about ghost's story. And it leads him to a haunted story of ghost's daughter locking up his father for years.
quote: A problematically scary story.

title: Race to the Future
logline: An AI tries to figure out what type of racing game people would bet on in the future. While doing that it uses a lot of undisclosed data of betting companies and a programmer decides to convince AI to share these secret pieces of information with him.
quote: An unlikely friendship.

title: Regret, Ambition, Revenge
logline: Arthur gathers his friends to share a childhood story that he hasn't shared before. As he tells the story, his friends realize that it somehow connects with each of their childhood. And Arthur became their friend because of these weird connections but with a purpose… Which they don't know yet.
quote: I couldn't believe how Arthur planned all these…

title: Cleanse by the Ocean
logline: Two pirates are left behind by their crew on the journey to the fountain of youth. Luckily they copied the map and plan to steal a ship to race them. The only problem is that while creating a crew they cannot choose pirates. They need to somehow lure honest men into this adventure.
quote: Pirates who are masterful with marketing…

title: Rabbit Gift Wrap
logline: Unity loses the gift her girlfriend desperately wanted after a crazy night out. And she has only one day until the birthday. She starts recreating the night before to find out where she lost it but things doesn't seem as she remembers…
quote: Alice in Wonderland but without magic.

title: No One Gets to Decide
logline: An insecure software engineer who debugs simulation models for laser propulsion gets assigned to monitor a spacecraft system that's connected to a launch next month. This becomes the most difficult period of his life as he faces uncertainty about the long-term consequences of his decisions and the resistance he faces from the higher-ups who disagree with him.
quote: The constant fight between insecurity and responsibility.

title: Find Me
logline: Chloe's encounter with a magical spirit upended her life when the spirit took over and started forcing her to do everything she ever wanted but feared. Just as things were getting interesting the magical spirit disappeared leaving a note that says ‘find me.’
quote: In search for a missing life.

title: Firefight
logline: Two wrongly accused secret agents think the other one is conspiring against them as they wreak havoc between missions disrupting the harmony of their cities. As they try to catch each other the institutions that need to deal with this creates even more complication by providing funding for both of them.
quote: A series of misunderstandings…

title: Error
logline: In a world of automation and the goal for the eradication of human error, one of the last mechanics trying to fix the city infrastructure system finds himself in the secret underground communities of people on the verge of a revolt. But the mechanic's strong desire to end humanity kicks in and he does everything he can to stop this movement.
quote: His evolution was a sight to see.

title: Agitating Conscience
logline: A professional business coach causes tens of companies to go bankrupt because of the advice he gives them. After one of the bitter founders curses at him, he starts therapy and realizes all the wrong decisions he made and the pieces of bad advice he gave stem from one reason: insecurity.
quote: His ambition to not fail others made him overcome his own demons.

title: Ghost Translator
logline: A translator needs to decipher a message that's been found under a man's pillow but it turns out that the words don't belong to any language at all. This sends the translator into an investigation of the supernatural.
quote: Beginning of a trilogy: translator turns into a supernatural detective…

title: Paystream
logline: A gamer's stream gets interrupted by a viewer who claims he has purchased the entire game and he wants to see what the gamer would pay for it other than money to keep playing. At first, the gamer tries to convince the viewer not to shut down the game for other players but as his stream gets a lot of views he feels intrigued to keep this going…
quote: We as humans always forget that we each value things differently.

title: Curse of Me
logline: A journalist decides to investigate strange things that the townspeople claim to have happened in their town but what she doesn't know is that all of these strange occurrences connect to her heritage in the town.
quote: A family of witches… A curse of generations.

title: Nice to Meet You
logline: Derek wants to test the limits of his friendship with Frank who always says he can count on him. Their day starts with stealing medicine from a hospital but as the night goes even crazier with Derek's plans, Frank figures out what his friend is doing and this game turns into a race to find each other line they won't cross…
quote: This was an insane ride.

title: Indulgence
logline: After spending years in prison Joel picks up a habit of creating a murder weapon from everything he touches. In order to get around the law after he is released, Joel gets inside his parole officer's head and together they plot the hypothetically perfect murder which in this case might actually happen…
quote: I felt Joel was in my head also.

title: Knowing Unknowing
logline: A year ago Henry remembers he wanted to know what was going on in his life. A year later, he feels the opposite, but he doesn't know why. So, he starts a journey to discover the things that helped him during the year.
quote: An uplifting Christmas story at its best.

title: My Superficial Dilemma
logline: Frank who wants to build an art curating company and become an entrepreneur struggles due to his alcoholism. In order to stop his alcohol consumption he starts attending every class possible: modern dance, theater, voice acting, and many more. But his plan backfires since everyone in classes praises how relaxed he is at any moment…
quote: What type of status would you have chosen?

title: Birthday Runner
logline: Fuat who is a people pleaser takes on too much he can bite when he said okay to three different birthday parties at the same time. And on each party he has different responsibilities he needs to fulfill. But things obviously start to go bad for him and realizes no one actually cares about him. So, he takes on a mission to make all the parties about him at the end of the night…
quote: It was an ambitious task I don't know how he changed that much in a single night.

title: Heritage
logline: Grandpa Luke's inheritance becomes something of a mystery among the Waller family because he left everything to a person named Lilly McBiggens who no one knows. Finding who she is becomes a race among family since they think they can convince her to give millions of dollars back. In time the race gets dirty and the family members start to show their real faces…
quote: Grandpa Luke was one hell of a trickster.

title: Rogue Gambler
logline: A gambler living in a small town starts making a list of what he wants to do when he wins a lot of money before even winning any proper prize. As he keeps adding to his list his wishes become real in the most unexpected circumstances. Would this make him stop gambling even more?
quote: He chose a rogue life.

title: Test Group
logline: In academy research, a bunch of delusional and conspiracy theorist people have been brought together. They have been told they will be working on the world's biggest problems and solving them. But as weeks passes by they start to learn how to communicate their theories better with the public and the group becomes the place where all conspiracies are born.
quote: Every possible conspiracy theory starts from somewhere and this is where that somewhere is…

title: Sleeping Spirits
logline: A kid finds a book named “Sleeping Spirits” and starts reading about how spirits can go into different magical worlds and have adventures. First night with the book in her room, her spirit wakes up while she's sleeping and starts floating away into another dimensions where she meets a boy who doesn't believe in himself. So, she helps him find his confidence that is in the form of a fox running away from them…
quote: The adventures of Magical Marta.

title: Pattern Surfer
logline: A carpenter finds a way to insert himself inside the patterns surrounding him to explore the fabric of the universe. But his neighbor who is always jealous of him realizes he can affect the weather in the pattern world by using lights and shade and dedicates his life to give the carpenter hell.
quote: I cannot wait to see how sounds affects everything in the second movie.

title: A Day in My Perfect Future
logline: Albert, who prepares a meal for his friends who came to visit on New Year's Eve, returns to various memories from his life, but realizes that his memories are intertwined with the future. The couple he sees in his memories from time to time is the love of his life and his self actualized true self. No matter how much about the future he wants to ask them, he can only be able to watch them for one night in order not to spoil this beautiful dream.
quote: Have you set new year goals yet?
